definitions.explanation: showing skill and cleverness, often in a cunning way

examples.japanese: {巧妙|こうみょう}な⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧だ。
⟦{詐欺師|さぎし}→詐欺師：10176_sagishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{巧妙|こうみょう}な⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騙|だま}された→騙す：02286_damasu⟧。
examples.english: I was deceived by the swindler's ingenious methods.

examples.japanese: {巧妙|こうみょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕組|しく}まれた→仕組む：11435_shikumu⟧⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧だった。
examples.english: It was a cleverly designed trap.

notes:
{巧妙|こうみょう} describes cleverness that is often cunning or strategic, not always positive.

WORD TYPE:
- Na-adjective
- Adverbial form: {巧妙|こうみょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧

WRITING:
- {巧|こう} (skillful)
- ⟦{妙|みょう}→妙：01766_myou⟧ (mysterious, strange, clever)

USAGE:
- Often implies cunning or craftiness
- Frequently used for deceptive or strategic schemes
- Can be neutral (skillful technique) or negative (devious)
- More literary/formal than ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧
- Crime reports (fraud, scams)
- Political maneuvering
- Strategic planning
- Literary descriptions

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な⟦{手口|てぐち}→手口：12756_teguchi⟧ (clever trick/method)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧ (ingenious technique)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}な⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧ (clever trap)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕組|しく}む→仕組む：11435_shikumu⟧ (cleverly devise)
- {巧妙|こうみょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧ (cleverly hide)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧ (skillful - neutral/positive)
- ⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧ (dexterous, handy)
- ⟦{狡猾|こうかつ}→狡猾：07639_koukatsu⟧ (cunning - more negative)
- ⟦{巧|たく}み→巧み：07153_takumi⟧ (skillful - more positive)

REGISTER: Formal. Common in news reports and formal writing.
